Start with one useful workflow

An inquiry comes in. The follow-up is already organized.

Here’s one example of how the pieces could work together:

  1. 01

    A customer gets in touch

    Your website form asks for the details you need to respond.

  2. 02

    The details go where you need them

    The inquiry is added to your customer list or spreadsheet, without retyping it.

  3. 03

    A follow-up task is created

The setup depends on your tools and how you work. We’ll test it with real examples and make sure you know how to manage it.
